description: Stored historical company risk category readings and their observed input changes. Shows dates, computation times, formula versions, score changes, changing input coverage and measurement bases. Use for 'how has X's risk changed?' and 'which inputs changed?'. These are retained category scores, not a complete daily series or proof of causation. Missing history is unknown, never a zero risk score. Read-only; does not run risk computation or paid discovery. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

detail.description: Summary keeps scores, explanations and up to three changed inputs per category; full includes stored input terms and all returned term changes.

limit.description: Latest stored run dates to return, oldest first. Retention and gaps vary. Full detail supports at most six dates.

ticker.description: Exact native Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL or SAP.

name: get_company_risk_history
title: Get company risk history and changes
